## Quality gates

- [ ] Used template and populated `submission.json`; README, report, evidence, PoC match each finding ID
- [ ] Reproducible lab with an exact target commit and default/non-default settings documented
- [ ] PoC is bounded, non-destructive and authorized; no real-user data or secrets included
- [ ] Raw captures are genuine (redactions marked); no simulated logs are presented as evidence
- [ ] Every claim is limited to verified privilege, version and impact
- [ ] No self-issued CVE ID, fabricated CNA fields, or invalid `state: RESERVED` CVE record
- [ ] Public disclosure specifically approved by human maintainer
- [ ] Validator/CI result supplied below, including skipped tests
